rationale: The Act names an office for corps member security, the Local Government Committee (section 8(3)(d)), but sets no procedure and limits the duty to members deployed to the local government area; no national office is named.
No published risk assessment of states, routes or places of primary assignment; placement criteria in section 9(4) do not include security.

States and LGAs have been excluded from postings in practice, but no criteria, procedure or responsible office are published; exemption names no security ground, refusing a posting is penalised and relocation requests have no stated grounds.
No provision for risk information or consent; the pledge commits members to serve wherever deployed.

Local Government Committees collect members from camp and return them for passing out within the state of service (an office with a defined task), and the Director-General has issued travel directives; journeys between states, to camp and from camp, are not covered by any procedure.
States provide camps and the Bye-laws restrict what members bring into camp, but no camp security standard or responsible office exists.
The Local Government Committee, which includes a police representative, has a duty to ensure security at the place of primary assignment; no procedure is set.
Security advice is given in addresses and one safety rule appears in the Bye-laws; no training curriculum is published and the 2021 safety guidance was not adopted.
No incident reporting procedure; airing grievances in the media and addressing the press on policy are disciplinary offences.
No published crisis management or kidnap response plan; response in the 2026 Kogi abduction relied on security agencies.

Health and life insurance from call-up and an insurance office at headquarters; insurer, cover limits and claim procedure are not published, and no provision for psychosocial or other post-incident support is published.
The Directorate reports annually but is not required to report harm to corps members; the post-incident review announced in 2026 has no published terms.
